description: Law, safety, ethics, baseline accessibility, confidentiality and licence restrictions
resolution_rule: May prohibit an action or require an accommodation; cannot be bypassed by profile, author, protocol, institution, AI or technical convenience.

description: Consent, refusal, withdrawal, privacy and participant rights
resolution_rule: Overrides research/institutional convenience; may invalidate collection, assignment or continued participation.
Control values required for comparability, except where higher rights require deviation; deviations must be recorded.

description: Institutional assessment, governance, confidentiality, catalogue and publication rules
resolution_rule: Applies within lawful/ethical bounds; cannot silently change a locked condition.

description: Required subject, pedagogical, accessibility, legal or privacy reviews and approvals
resolution_rule: Controls readiness/publication for the reviewed scope and revision; no automatic self-approval.

description: Workspace owner, author, teacher or tutor configuration
resolution_rule: Controls authored structure and allowed choices where not locked by higher authority.

description: Learner choices and protected accommodations within the permitted space
resolution_rule: Applies at learner scope; protected accessibility needs may outrank ordinary course preferences.

description: Named profile, deployment profile and deterministic product defaults
resolution_rule: Fills unspecified values; never overrides explicit higher-scope decisions.

description: Validated adaptive rule explicitly authorized for a target and evidence basis
resolution_rule: May propose or apply values only within its granted scope, transparency, override, rollback and snapshot policy.

description: AI suggestion, draft, critique or recommendation
resolution_rule: Advisory by default; cannot promote its own output or override human/rights/protocol authority.

description: Available capability, offline state and deployment support
resolution_rule: Not an authority source. Unsupported values produce explicit error/unavailable state or an already-authorized fallback; no silent degradation.
